about: The crew: other vendors' own command-line agents, each with its own login, that take scripted work while a person keeps their Claude seat. A member runs only on a price-table row whose use is 'automated' (a pay-as-you-go API key): every coding and token plan read on 02.10.2026 forbids non-interactive use, and a subscription's login inside someone else's agent is not taken. 'use' here is a copy of billcall's row, used only when billcall's price table is not on this computer.

codex.login: codex login --with-api-key  (reads the key from standard input; an OpenAI API key, not a ChatGPT sign-in)

gemini.login: GEMINI_API_KEY from Google AI Studio, set in the job's environment

qwen.login: a Model Studio pay-as-you-go key (OPENAI_API_KEY, OPENAI_BASE_URL, OPENAI_MODEL or ~/.qwen/settings.json); headless mode accepts key auth only

kimi.login: a Moonshot platform API key in kimi's own configuration (not the Kimi Code membership)
kimi.note: --print auto-approves every tool call; gatecall lets kimi work only in a training folder.
